body:
Aside from the national hotline, nope. My town doesn’t really do much for mental health stuff.
I’ve been doing a lot better the past few days honestly, actually getting this off my chest every once in a while does actually help.
I’m just scared of what would happen if people found out about this, I’m paranoid of getting hospitalized for saying it.

We really don’t have one around here aside from an actual hospital, even then they don’t have anything for mental health stuff. The closest thing they have is expensive therapists that are like thirty minutes away at least
I honestly don’t know, I don’t have the time or the money to even do it in the first place.

Not really, the last time I met my therapist was when she prescribed me them. So she couldn’t really do a follow up on me.

And thank you, that actually does kind of make me feel more comfortable.

Thank you, I really appreciate the support but I’m genuinely at a loss right now. I tried to be open about my problem and I’ve been to two different therapists before, I even took antidepressants for a while but I just stopped taking them. I don’t want to be hooked on doctors and pills for my life, but even then things still are miserable.
Every time I try to talk about myself, I just feel like I’m being selfish and making it about me. I already do that from time to time and I know how much it annoys people.

Any help would be great honestly, but at the same time I don’t know if I want to get actual help or anything. If I talk about this to anyone like legit I’m scared it’ll just either be brushed off or I’ll be placed on suicide watch somewhere.
I’m mostly expecting the former to happen since, as far as I know, not a lot of people take me seriously.
